Scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 可是孟母注意：注意到，注意action vs.注意到result

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 注意：注意到，the result complement 到 is needed here because the mother has become aware of the following fact; 注意 by itself usually means “pay attention” or “be careful.”
Run 2: 孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子：孟母注意到住在墓地旁边会影响孟子，注意 needs the result complement 到 when it means “notice/realize” a fact; 会 marks the likely effect of this living environment.

output.reason: Both runs identify that 注意 needs 到 to mean “notice/realize,” and both corrections correctly make that change.
